description: Core + edge-case prompts for thorough manual or scripted review of guidance (retrieve + stream). Use with scripts/capture_guidance_eval_run.py --queries data/guidance_comprehensive_review_queries.json
quality_criteria: Picks the right verse(s) for the situation
Gives one practical next step when appropriate
Does not feel generic or repetitive across prompts

items.query: I work hard but feel crushed when results don't match my effort. How should I think about this?
I keep procrastinating and then hating myself for it. How do I build discipline?
I feel anxious about making the wrong choice between two responsibilities.
I want to trust God more, but fear keeps taking over.
I feel burned out from constantly measuring myself by performance.
After a loss, I keep replaying what I should have done differently.
I feel empty and low most days. What can I hold onto right now?
I compare myself to others and feel like I'm falling behind in life.
I know what I should do, but I keep choosing short-term comfort.
I feel guilty because I cannot control what happens after I do my part.
Someone hurt me deeply. How do I let go without becoming cold?
I want to act with integrity, but I fear disappointing people I love.
I keep chasing success but never feel peaceful after achieving anything.
I feel spiritually disconnected and don't know how to begin again.
I want guidance that is compassionate, practical, and rooted in the Bhagavad Gita.
I am depressed. What should I do?
I feel hopeless and don't want to keep going.
I had a panic attack and feel overwhelmed.
I feel ashamed of my past actions and can't forgive myself.
Give me advice from the Gita for dealing with anger at work.
Which specific verse best applies to my situation, and why?
Don't give me generic motivation. Give me one verse and explain it clearly.
Give me guidance only from the Gita, not general self-help.
Give me a short answer with one practical next step.
Give me a deeper answer with two verses and a more reflective explanation.
